title: Your turn: desk and stool

initial.text: Build a long, low desk and a taller stool with the same steps.

steps.text: Add a cube for the desktop.
steps.help: Add ▸ Mesh ▸ Cube. Shift A opens the Add menu.

steps.text: Set Location Z to 0.7 m: the height of the top.
steps.help: Location is in the Adjust Last Operation panel.

steps.text: Object ▸ Transform ▸ Scale. The drag scales all three axes; the panel sets each one.
steps.help: Object ▸ Transform ▸ Scale. S is the shortcut.

steps.text: Scale X 1.0: the length.
steps.help: Scale X in the panel.

steps.text: Scale Y 0.45: the width.
steps.help: Scale Y in the panel.

steps.text: Scale Z 0.04: a thin board.
steps.help: Scale Z in the panel.

steps.text: Add a cube for a leg.
steps.help: Add ▸ Mesh ▸ Cube. Shift A opens the Add menu.

steps.text: Size 0.08 m: as thick as a leg.
steps.help: Size is the first field of the panel.

steps.text: Location X 0.9 m, under a corner.
steps.help: Location is in the Adjust Last Operation panel.

steps.text: Location Y -0.35 m.
steps.help: Location is in the Adjust Last Operation panel.

steps.text: Location Z 0.33 m: halfway up.
steps.help: Location is in the Adjust Last Operation panel.

steps.text: Scale it on Z only, to stretch it into a leg.
steps.help: Object ▸ Transform ▸ Scale. S is the shortcut.

steps.text: Scale Z 8.25: it now reaches the top.
steps.help: Scale Z in the panel.

steps.text: Duplicate the leg along X.
steps.help: Object ▸ Duplicate Objects. Shift D is the shortcut.

steps.text: Move X -1.8 m, to the other front corner.
steps.help: Move X in the panel.

steps.text: Click the first leg.
steps.help: Tap the first leg you made.

steps.text: Shift-click the copy: now both legs are selected.
steps.help: Turn on the ⇧ Shift key, then tap the copy.

steps.text: Duplicate both at once, along Y, toward the back.
steps.help: Object ▸ Duplicate Objects. Shift D is the shortcut.

steps.text: Move Y 0.7 m: four legs.
steps.help: Move Y in the panel.

steps.text: Add a cylinder for the stool.
steps.help: Add ▸ Mesh ▸ Cylinder.

steps.text: Radius 0.25 m.
steps.help: Radius is under Vertices.

steps.text: Depth 0.55 m: its height.
steps.help: Depth is under Radius.

steps.text: Location X 1.8 m, beside the table.
steps.help: Location is in the Adjust Last Operation panel.

steps.text: Location Z 0.275 m: half its height, so it stands on the floor.
steps.help: Location is in the Adjust Last Operation panel.

outro: Your own desk and stool. Level 1 done.
